title: Place a footprint from an IntLib onto the board
summary: Searches an integrated library with the integrated library manager, finds a component's PCBLIB footprint model and places it on the current board with PCBObjectFactory and LoadFromLibrary using the IntegratedLibraryName key.
phrasings: place a component from an integrated library on a PCB
list the models of an IntLib component
find the footprint model of a library component
load a footprint from an IntLib with LoadFromLibrary

commands.name: PlaceComponent
commands.description: Place a footprint from an integrated library on the board
commands.params: Lib=<.IntLib path or file name> (default Miscellaneous Devices.IntLib)|Component=<name> (default Res Pack1)|Footprint=<model> (default SOIC16_M)|X=<mil>|Y=<mil> (from the board origin; default centre of the board outline)|LoadKey=<key> (optional; default tries IntegratedLibraryName then FileName)

commands.name: ListModels
commands.description: List the models of an integrated library component (read-only)
